title: Record coverage and disease context in hearing-loss-related ClinVar records
description: Scientific analysis code, fixed-input metadata, complete derived results, five figures, three main tables and fifteen supporting tables comparing text-based, HPO-linked and ClinGen gene-based ClinVar record selection. Includes disease-context extraction, figure/table provenance and a fixed-input reproduction entrypoint. Large fixed source inputs are supplied as a checksummed release asset.
